description: This file contains unit tests for the FocusMapping logic related to DPAD navigation in an Android TV application. Specifically, it validates the behavior of the computeTargetIndex function, which maps focus indices between rows with boundary and sentinel handling.

classes.name: FocusMappingTest
classes.description: A test class that validates the focus index mapping logic for navigation between UI rows.

methods.name: computeTargetIndex
methods.description: Calculates target focus index when moving from row r to r-1, handling boundary cases, sentinel values, and clamping.
